children.name: Save Value type with custom range [10,50]

record.title: Save Value type with custom range [10,50]
record.expected_result:
1. Gradebook setup is visible; the existing manual-item count is recorded.
2. The full form is shown; Value is selected and numeric controls are enabled.
3. The supplied test data is entered. The ID number identifies this case without changing the name-length data.
4. Min/Max are editable, Scale is disabled, and the specified values are entered.
5. The same item is stored with the exact ID number, name and Grade type; numeric range is [10,50] for Value, or the selected scale is retained.
6. Only this case's item is deleted; its row disappears and the original manual-item count is restored.
record.precondition: Moodle 5.1.8 at http://127.0.0.1:9501, English UI, Asia/Bangkok. Log in at /login/index.php as teacher01 / 1234 (or run 00_Setup_Login first). Course 1 id=2; teacher01 has Editing teacher rights. Site grade_report_showmin=1. Single grade category using Natural aggregation; no student grades on test items. Global scale "Separate and Connected ways of knowing" exists. Use the full URL /grade/edit/tree/item.php?courseid=2, not the quick-add dialog. ID number F003-TCnnn must be unused for the case; remove only leftover test data from an interrupted run. For case 030 run before 31 Dec 2030. Existing unrelated items may remain.
record.notes: ECP / decision R1 / main flow. Each successful case reopens the exact saved item, verifies its values and deletes only that item through the UI.

steps.action: Open Gradebook setup for course id=2. Record the number of manual-item rows before this case.
steps.expected: Gradebook setup is visible; the existing manual-item count is recorded.

steps.action: Open the full New grade item form directly at http://127.0.0.1:9501/grade/edit/tree/item.php?courseid=2.
steps.expected: The full form is shown; Value is selected and numeric controls are enabled.

steps.action: Enter Item name = 'F003 011' and ID number = F003-TC011.
steps.expected: The supplied test data is entered. The ID number identifies this case without changing the name-length data.

steps.action: Select Grade type Value; clear and enter Minimum grade '10' and Maximum grade '50'.
steps.expected: Min/Max are editable, Scale is disabled, and the specified values are entered.

steps.action: Click Save changes. After redirecting to Gradebook setup, identify the newly appended manual row, record its item ID, and open its full edit form.
steps.expected: The same item is stored with the exact ID number, name and Grade type; numeric range is [10,50] for Value, or the selected scale is retained.

steps.action: Click Cancel to leave the verified edit form. In the row with the recorded item ID, open Cell actions -> Delete and confirm Delete.
steps.expected: Only this case's item is deleted; its row disappears and the original manual-item count is restored.
